object_description: long, quiet four-storey bar along the street with a street-side arcade and a buried gymnasium
design_condition: the long narrow bar accompanies the street with an arcade defining its base and address, leaving a large open space towards the small-scale neighbourhood, with the gymnasium buried to create a spacious esplanade

positive: The long and quiet four-storey building accompanies the street
An arcade facing the street defines the base and creates an address to the city
The narrow structure creates a large open space towards the small-scale neighbourhood
Burying the gymnasium pays off and creates a spacious esplanade
The building clad with concrete elements is beautifully proportioned and robustly designed
The concrete facade with a large proportion of glass is well conceivable in this location
Public uses under the arcade do a great deal for the district by enlivening the public space
A two-storey staircase with cascading stairs connects the two entrance levels
The proposal develops a clear attitude towards the various sides of the building and the neighbourhood
The implied spaciousness on the park side and the row of trees suggest an urban front zone
The two main staircases are clearly arranged from the entrance hall and give access to four clusters per floor
The kindergarten outdoor space is cut into the volume and integrated into the cluster structure
The gymnasium is structurally part of the whole but usable outside school hours
The simple and economical system allows great planning and operational flexibility
negative: The facility measures the entire length of the perimeter, so an extension would require building over the gymnasium
Such an extension would considerably weaken the school complex in urban terms
The proportion of glass is very high for a school use
It is unclear whether the mineral-hard concept was deliberate or the open space was given too little attention
The required outdoor areas are designated but not developed in concept, range of uses or quality
The vegetation concept is heavily zoned and does not correspond to the desired continuity of the park
